rows.name: additional_checkout_buttons
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/additional_checkout_buttons, fetched 2026-09-02): "Returns `true` if a store has any payment providers with offsite checkouts, such as PayPal Express Checkout." No properties. Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/runtime.rb:143 `"additional_checkout_buttons" => false` (hard constant in Runtime#initialize global_assigns; comment at runtime.rb:141-142 says v1 has no offsite provider so false/empty is 'explicit stub'). runtime.rb:144 `"content_for_additional_checkout_buttons" => ""` likewise constant. The value is never derived from app/models/shop_payment_provider.rb (ShopPaymentProvider, provider ∈ Psp.registry.codes, line 8/33) — grep 'offsite' across app/models app/liquid app/services hits only the runtime.rb comment.
rows.fix: Derive from data instead of constant: in Runtime#initialize compute `ActsAsTenant.with_tenant(shop) { ShopPaymentProvider.where(shop_id: shop.id).any? { |p| Psp.registry[p.provider].offsite_checkout? } }` — add an `offsite_checkout` capability flag per PSP pack in config/limits.yml psp_packs (Airwallex hosted-payment-page = true when that flow is enabled) and set `content_for_additional_checkout_buttons` to the provider-rendered button HTML when true. Keep `false`/`""` when no provider is installed.

rows.name: all_country_option_tags
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/all_country_option_tags, fetched 2026-09-02): "Creates an `<option>` tag for each country." Each option: `<option value="United States" data-provinces="[...]">United States</option>` — value = country name, `data-provinces` = JSON-encoded array of subregions (empty array if none); page notes `country_option_tags` is the shipping-zone-restricted variant. No properties. Ours: runtime.rb:148 `"all_country_option_tags" => country_option_tags(shop)`; runtime.rb:171-175 `def country_option_tags(shop)` → `Checkouts::RateResolver.sellable_countries(shop:)` (app/services/checkouts/rate_resolver.rb:58-66 = active-market ∩ shipping-zone countries) `.map { |code| %(<option value="#{code}">#{code}</option>) }.join`. Deviations: (1) value/text are ISO codes not country names (runtime.rb:147 comment admits 顯示名暫用國碼); (2) no `data-provinces` attribute at all, although app/liquid/theme_engine/shopify_global.rb:87-88 CountryProvinceSelector reads `data-provinces` and JSON.parses it — so province selects always collapse to empty; (3) set is the shipping-zone-filtered set, i.e. semantically `country_option_tags`, not the 'each country' set. `country_option_tags` global itself is not assigned in runtime.rb:102-149.
rows.fix: In Runtime#country_option_tags emit `%(<option value="#{name}" data-provinces="#{ERB::Util.html_escape(JSON.generate(provinces))}">#{name}</option>)` with `name = Checkouts::CountryNames.label(code)` and `provinces` from a new platform dictionary (e.g. config/countries.yml or lib/geo/subdivisions.rb: code → [[iso_3166_2_code, name], …]) matching the `[code, name]` pair shape CountryProvinceSelector expects (shopify_global.rb:93). Split the two globals: `all_country_option_tags` iterates the full dictionary; add `"country_option_tags" => …` over `RateResolver.sellable_countries` (current behaviour). Add a spec asserting HK/US rows carry `data-provinces` and that value is the English name.

rows.name: color

Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:1566 `class LinkListDrop < Liquid::Drop`; :1573 `def title = @menu.title`; :1574 `def handle = @menu.handle`; :1576-1580 `def links` (root items where parent_menu_item_id nil, sorted by position → LinkDrop; nested via LinkDrop#links drops.rb:1549-1551 using @item.children); :1582 `def levels = 3` — hard-coded constant, not the actual nesting depth of the menu. Data source: menus/menu_items tables (db/schema.rb:868-896). No spec/test references LinkListDrop (grep spec test → none).
missing_properties: levels (returns constant 3 regardless of actual depth; official = number of nested levels present)
rows.fix: In LinkListDrop replace `def levels = 3` with a computed depth: walk menu_items via parent_menu_item_id (already loaded through Menu.includes(:menu_items) at drops.rb:1593) and return `[max_depth, 3].min` — 1 when only root links, 2 when any root link has children, 3 when any grandchild exists. Add a spec with 1/2/3-level fixtures.

rows.name: localization
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/localization, fetched 2026-09-02): available_countries (array of country), available_languages (array of shop_locale), country (country), language (shop_locale), market (market). Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:1671 `class LocalizationDrop < BaseDrop` with attrs language/country/market/available_countries/available_languages (:1672-1676); `available_countries` is built as `[ country ].compact` (:1674). Real values come from app/services/storefront/localization_context.rb:24 `def drop(web_presence:, locale_tag:)`: available_languages = presence locales open_to_buyers ∧ published with iso_code/endonym_name/primary/root_url (:25-37); language = current (:39-43); country = ONLY `market.region_country_codes.first` as a Hash with `"name" => code` and `currency.symbol => nil` (:46-50); market = `{ "handle" => market.handle, "id" => market.id }` (:52-54) — plain Hash, no metafields. Wiring: runtime.rb:110-111 — with web_presence uses LocalizationContext; without it falls back to synthetic single language, country nil, market nil, available_countries [].
missing_properties: available_countries (only the market's first region country; not all countries selectable across active markets; country.name = ISO code, currency.symbol nil)
country.name (real country name; currently the ISO code)
rows.fix: 1) In Storefront::LocalizationContext build available_countries from all `Market.active` regions of the shop (MarketRegion joined to Market.active, same set used by runtime.rb:171 country_option_tags per 鐵律 7) as CountryDrop objects with iso_code, name (from a country-name dictionary keyed by ISO code — add to platform locale data), currency {iso_code, symbol from the locale/currency dictionary}, market; 2) select `country` = the region matching the current presence's market containing the request country, default first region; 3) replace the market Hash with a MarketDrop (see market row).

rows.name: market
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/market, fetched 2026-09-02): handle (string), id (string), metafields (metafields). Ours: no MarketDrop class in app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb (class list drops.rb:12-1966 has none); market reaches Liquid only as a plain Hash `{ "handle" => market.handle, "id" => market.id }` at app/services/storefront/localization_context.rb:52-54, passed into LocalizationDrop (drops.rb:1673 `"market" => market`). `id` is an Integer (markets.id bigint, db/schema.rb:825) not a string. `metafields` absent. Model app/models/market.rb has handle/name/status/market_type/is_primary.
rows.fix: Add `class MarketDrop < Liquid::Drop` (handle = @market.handle, id = @market.id.to_s, metafields = MetafieldsRootDrop.new(@market)) and use it in Storefront::LocalizationContext#drop in place of the Hash; MetafieldNamespaceDrop already scopes by owner_type/owner_id (drops.rb:339-344) so `Market` rows work once admin can write metafields with owner_type 'Market' (limits.yml custom_data owner_type_count lists 市場).

rows.name: media
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/media, fetched 2026-09-02): alt, id, media_type (image|model|video|external_video), position (nil for file_reference metafields), preview_image (image). Ours: image media → app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:104 `class ImageDrop` (id :111, alt :112, media_type "image" :116, position :117, preview_image=self :122); external_video → drops.rb:83 `class ExternalVideoMediaDrop` (id :89, media_type :90, alt :93, position :94, `def preview_image = nil` :96 — official type is image); placeholder → drops.rb:26 PlaceholderImageDrop (media_type :44, position 1 :45, preview_image self :43); file-backed image → drops.rb:51 FileImageDrop (id :58, alt :59, media_type :72, preview_image :76, no position). ProductDrop#media drops.rb:518-527 merges only `images` (stored_file rows) + external videos; rows with media_type 'video' or 'model' (media.media_type column db/schema.rb:851) have no drop and are silently omitted. No drop exists for media_type 'video' or 'model'.
missing_properties: media_type = video (hosted video drop absent; rows dropped from product.media)
preview_image for external_video (returns nil; official returns an image)
position on FileImageDrop (absent; official nil only for file_reference metafields)
rows.fix: Add VideoMediaDrop and ModelMediaDrop (id, alt, media_type, position, preview_image, plus sources/aspect_ratio per objects/video and objects/model) and include them in ProductDrop#media by media_type; give ExternalVideoMediaDrop a preview_image built from a stored thumbnail (add poster file_id on media or derive from external host) instead of nil; add `def position = nil` to FileImageDrop for the file_reference case.

rows.name: metafield
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/metafield, fetched 2026-09-02): properties list? (boolean), type (string), value (type-dependent: reference types → objects, file_reference → generic_file/media, number_* → number, date/date_time → date string, json → object, boolean, color → color object, weight/volume/dimension → measurement, rating → rating, money → money; list.* variants; deprecated integer/json_string/string). Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:303 `class MetafieldDrop < Liquid::Drop`; :310 `def value = @row.value` (raw json, no per-type coercion); :311 `def type = @row.metafield_definition.value_type`; :312 to_s; :313 json_refused?; :315-318 liquid_method_missing → nil. No `list?` method (falls to liquid_method_missing → nil). Data: metafields.value json + metafield_definitions.value_type (db/schema.rb:898-925).
missing_properties: value typed resolution (product_reference/collection_reference/variant_reference/page_reference/file_reference → drops; color → ColorDrop; weight/volume/dimension → measurement; rating → rating; money → money; rich_text_field → rich-text object; list.* → arrays with count)
rows.fix: Add `def list? = type.to_s.start_with?("list.")` and a `resolve_value` dispatcher in MetafieldDrop keyed on definition value_type: *_reference → look up Product/Collection/ProductVariant/Page by GID/id and wrap in existing ProductDrop/CollectionDrop/VariantDrop/PageDrop; file_reference → FileImageDrop/media drop; color → ColorDrop.new(hex) (drops.rb:1689); weight/volume/dimension → MeasurementDrop; money → money Hash (amount cents per 鐵律 3 → Money::Decimal only at serialization); rating → RatingDrop; list.* → map each element. Keep deprecated integer/json_string/string returning raw values.

rows.name: metafields

Ours: root drop app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:350 `class MetafieldsRootDrop < Liquid::Drop`, :358-360 liquid_method_missing(namespace) → MetafieldNamespaceDrop (dynamic, DB-backed). Attached only to ProductDrop: drops.rb:568-570 `def metafields = @metafields ||= MetafieldsRootDrop.new(@p)`. Other owners: ShopDrop drops.rb:1489 `def metafields = {}` (empty stub); ArticleDrop comment drops.rb:1188 "image/metafields/user v1 nil（91 §3.64）"; grep `def metafields` in drops.rb → only :568 and :1489 — CollectionDrop, VariantDrop, PageDrop, BlogDrop, ArticleDrop have none (liquid_method_missing → nil), market/location have no drops.

rows.name: money
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/money, fetched 2026-09-02): property currency(currency); direct reference yields "the monetary value expressed in cents". Ours: money-valued properties are bare Integer cents, not a drop — VariantDrop#price drops.rb:145 `= @v.price_cents`, #compare_at_price :146, ProductDrop#price drops.rb:533 (`variants.filter_map(&:price).min || 0`); filters consume Integer: filters.rb:159-171 `money`/`money_with_currency`/`format_money` (`input.to_f / 100.0`). Direct-reference-in-cents semantics therefore hold, but `.currency` on a money value is not available (Integer has no drop; no MoneyDrop class in drops.rb class list).
rows.fix: Introduce `MoneyDrop < Liquid::Drop` in drops.rb with `to_s`/`to_liquid` = cents Integer (so `{{ product.price }}` and `| money` keep working; make Filters#format_money accept the drop via `to_i`), `def currency = CurrencyDrop.new(iso_code)` (iso_code from @context.registers[:currency], set at runtime.rb:557), and `==`/`<=>` delegating to cents so Ella comparisons (`compare_at_price > price`) still work. Return it from VariantDrop#price/#compare_at_price (drops.rb:145-146) and ProductDrop price_* (drops.rb:533-541).

rows.name: option_with_value
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/option_with_value, fetched 2026-09-02): name(string) / value(product_option_value). Ours: ProductDrop#options_with_values drops.rb:587-593 returns ProductOptionDrop (drops.rb:364-397: name/position/values/selected_value) — i.e. the product_option shape; VariantDrop has no `options_with_values` method (drops.rb:132-277 exposes `options` (string array, :180-186), option1/2/3 only), and `liquid_method_missing` at drops.rb:233 returns nil for `variant.options_with_values`. No drop exposes a single `value` (product_option_value) property.
rows.fix: Add `OptionWithValueDrop` (name, value → OptionValueDrop drops.rb:404) in drops.rb and `VariantDrop#options_with_values` = `@v.option_values.sort_by(&:product_option_id).map { |ov| OptionWithValueDrop.new(ov.product_option.name, OptionValueDrop.new(ov, @product)) }` (reuse the join already used by VariantDrop#options drops.rb:180-186). Keep ProductDrop#options_with_values returning product_option drops (that is the official shape for product).

rows.name: page
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/page, fetched 2026-09-02): author / content / handle / id / metafields / published_at / template_suffix / title / url. Ours: PageDrop drops.rb:1416-1435 defines id(:1423) title(:1424) handle(:1425) content=body_html(:1426) url(:1428) published_at(:1429); `liquid_method_missing` (:1431-1434) returns nil for author/metafields/template_suffix. pages table db/schema.rb:1023-1037 has `template_suffix` column (:1031) but no author column; MetafieldsRootDrop (drops.rb:350-361) exists but is not wired to PageDrop.

rows.name: page_description
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/page_description, fetched 2026-09-02): "The meta description of the current page." (string; from resource SEO settings). Ours: runtime.rb:122 `"page_description" => nil` constant in @global_assigns; `grep -rn page_description app/liquid app/controllers/storefront` shows no other assignment (page_renderer.rb never reassigns). Data exists: seo_description columns at db/schema.rb:264, :1028 (pages), :1154; translations field_key meta_description at db/schema.rb:1556.
rows.fix: In PageRenderer#build_runtime (page_renderer.rb:293-311), after assigns, compute `runtime.assign("page_description", resource&.seo_description.presence || (product/collection/article/page body excerpt) || shop.description)` where resource = assigns["product"]||["collection"]||["article"]||["page"] (mirror page_image_for at :314-317); honour locale via translations_for(resource) field_key meta_description (db/schema.rb:1556).

rows.name: page_image
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/page_image, fetched 2026-09-02): "An image to be shown in search engine listings and social media previews for the current page." Product/collection: featured image; article: featured image; all other pages / no featured image: admin social sharing image fallback. Ours: page_renderer.rb:305-317 assigns page_image = `resource.featured_image` for assigns product/collection/article; comment at :305-307 states social-sharing-image fallback has no data plane ⇒ nil. `def featured_image` exists only on VariantDrop (drops.rb:195) and ProductDrop (drops.rb:530); ArticleDrop (drops.rb:1189-1228) and CollectionDrop (drops.rb:647-747) have no `featured_image` per `grep -n "def featured_image" drops.rb` ⇒ `respond_to?` at :316 is false for them and page_image is nil on collection/article pages.
rows.fix: (1) Add `def featured_image` to CollectionDrop (collection image column) and ArticleDrop (article image) in drops.rb so page_renderer.rb:316 `respond_to?(:featured_image)` resolves on those pages. (2) Add a shop-level `social_sharing_image_file_id` (shops table) + admin setting, then in page_image_for (page_renderer.rb:314) fall back to `FileImageDrop.new(shop.social_sharing_image)` when resource image is nil.

rows.name: page_title
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/page_title, fetched 2026-09-02): "The page title of the current page." (from resource SEO settings). Ours: runtime.rb:121 `"page_title" => shop.name` constant for every page type; no reassignment anywhere (`grep -rn page_title app/liquid app/controllers/storefront` → only runtime.rb:121). seo_title columns exist at db/schema.rb:265, :1029 (pages), :1155.
rows.fix: In PageRenderer#build_runtime (page_renderer.rb:293-311) assign `page_title` = resource.seo_title.presence || resource.title (product/collection/article/page), search → search terms, index → shop.name; apply locale translations (field_key meta_title, db/schema.rb:1556). Keep runtime.rb:121 shop.name only as the index/404 default.

rows.name: pages
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/pages, fetched 2026-09-02): "All of the pages on a store." accessible `pages.contact.title` / `pages['about-us'].title`; iterable, "Up to 50 pages per iteration" (paginate). Ours: runtime.rb:129 `"pages" => PagesDrop.new(shop:, url_prefix:)`; PagesDrop drops.rb:1378-1392 only implements `liquid_method_missing` (by-handle lookup `Page.find_by(shop_id:, handle:)` :1386) — no `each`/`to_a`/`size`, so `{% for page in pages %}` and `{% paginate pages by 50 %}` yield nothing; by-handle lookup also does not filter by `Page.visible` (compare page_renderer.rb:236-237 which uses `Page.visible(at:)`).
rows.fix: In PagesDrop (drops.rb:1378): include Enumerable, add `def each(&) = pages.each { |p| yield PageDrop.new(p, url_prefix: @url_prefix) }`, `def size`, `to_a`, backed by `Page.visible.where(shop_id: @shop.id).order(:title).limit(Limits.fetch(:liquid, :pages_paginate_max))` (add key = 50 with shopify.dev citation to config/limits.yml, 鐵律 6); apply `Page.visible` in liquid_method_missing (:1386) so unpublished pages don't leak; make PaginateDrop (drops.rb:1834) accept it.

rows.name: product
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/product, fetched 2026-09-02): 44 properties: available, category, collections, compare_at_price, compare_at_price_max, compare_at_price_min, compare_at_price_varies, content, created_at, description, featured_image, featured_media, first_available_variant, gift_card?, handle, has_only_default_variant, id, images, media, metafields, options, options_by_name, options_with_values, price, price_max, price_min, price_varies, published_at, quantity_price_breaks_configured?, requires_selling_plan, selected_or_first_available_selling_plan_allocation, selected_or_first_available_variant, selected_selling_plan, selected_selling_plan_allocation, selected_variant, selling_plan_groups, tags, template_suffix, title, type, url, variants, variants_count, vendor; content ≡ description; no deprecations. Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:457 `class ProductDrop < Liquid::Drop`. Real: id 477, title 478 (translation overlay), handle 479, vendor 482, type 483, tags 484, description 485, content 486, url 487, variants 491-493 (position-sorted VariantDrops), selected_or_first_available_variant 497-499, first_available_variant 501, selected_variant 503-505 (from ?variant=), has_only_default_variant 506, images 508-516 (only when media association preloaded, else []), media 518-528 (images + external videos by position), featured_image 530 (placeholder when none), featured_media 531, price/price_min/price_max/price_varies 533-536, compare_at_price/_min/_max/_varies 537-542, available 544, collections 553-566 (publication-scoped, [] without publication), metafields 568-570 (MetafieldsRootDrop), category 573-575 (CategoryDrop from category_gid; CategoryDrop#name = nil at drops.rb:289 — taxonomy name dictionary not stored), published_at 578-585, options_with_values 587-594 (ProductOptionDrop), options 602. Constant stubs (no storage in db/schema.rb products 1145-1163 / product_variants 1117-1135): gift_card? = false (545), requires_selling_plan = false (546), selling_plan_groups = [] (547), quantity_price_breaks_configured? = false (548), selected_or_first_available_selling_plan_allocation = nil (603). Missing entirely (fall to liquid_method_missing → nil, drops.rb:641-644): created_at (only emitted inside as_storefront_json at 614, not as a Liquid property), template_suffix (no `template_suffix` column on products — schema 1145-1163; pages/articles/blogs have it), variants_count, options_by_name, selected_selling_plan, selected_selling_plan_allocation. Note drops.rb:639-640 comment deliberately omits `status`.
missing_properties: category (CategoryDrop#name nil — taxonomy name not stored)
gift_card? (constant false, no gift-card product storage)
rows.fix: In ProductDrop (drops.rb:457): add `def created_at = @p.created_at&.iso8601` (same style as ArticleDrop drops.rb:1208); add `def variants_count = variants.size`; add `def options_by_name = OptionsByNameDrop` — a Liquid::Drop whose liquid_method_missing(name) returns `options_with_values.find { |o| o.name.casecmp?(name.to_s) }` (official: case-insensitive name lookup); add products.template_suffix column (migration, string, nullable) + `def template_suffix = @p.template_suffix` and honour it in page_renderer.rb template_key_for (line 129) the way `?view=` is honoured; add explicit `def selected_selling_plan = nil` and `def selected_selling_plan_allocation = nil` stubs until selling plans exist (cart_line_items.selling_plan_id already reserved, schema 97). For gift_card?, selling plans and quantity price breaks: add real storage (products.gift_card boolean; selling_plan_groups/selling_plans tables; variant_quantity_price_breaks table) when those features are scheduled — until then keep explicit constants. For category name: import Shopify Standard Product Taxonomy as a platform dictionary table (鐵律 2 ③ procedure) and resolve CategoryDrop#name (drops.rb:289) from it.

rows.name: product_option_value
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/product_option_value, fetched 2026-09-02): properties available (boolean), id (number), name (string), product_url (string; URL if associated with another product [combined listings], nil otherwise), selected (boolean), swatch (swatch or nil when no color/image data), variant (variant; selected_or_first_available_variant if selected, matching variant if unselected). Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:404 `class OptionValueDrop < Liquid::Drop`; drops.rb:411 `def id = @ov.id`, 412 `def name = @ov.value`, 416 `def available = matching_variants.any?(&:available)`, 418-421 `def selected` (value belongs to selected_or_first_available_variant), 424 `def variant = matching_variants.find(&:available) || matching_variants.first`, 428-431 `def product_url` → representative variant URL of the same product (comment at 425-427 flags this as ours: official returns nil unless combined listing; ours returns a URL always), 433 `def swatch = nil # 無 swatch 存儲（缺口分析 §B 登記）`; 438-444 `==` overridden for drop/string comparison. option_values table (db/schema.rb:943-948) has only value/position — no swatch color/image columns. Deviations: swatch is a constant nil stub (no storage); product_url semantic differs from official (official nil for same product); `variant` for the selected value does not explicitly return selected_or_first_available_variant (it returns first available matching variant, which can differ when the selected variant is sold out but another variant with this value is available).
missing_properties: product_url (returns own-product variant URL; official returns nil unless combined listing)
variant (selected case should return product.selected_or_first_available_variant per official text)
rows.fix: 1) Add swatch storage: option_values columns `swatch_color` (hex string) and `swatch_image_stored_file_id` (FK to files), plus a `SwatchDrop` (color → ColorDrop drops.rb:1689, image → FileImageDrop drops.rb:51) returned from OptionValueDrop#swatch when either is present. 2) Align `variant` with official: `def variant; selected ? @product.selected_or_first_available_variant : (matching_variants.find(&:available) || matching_variants.first); end`. 3) product_url: return nil for same-product values (official) and only a URL once combined listings exist; Ella's data-product-url consumer must then fall back to product.url — verify against fixture product-variant-options.liquid before changing (drops.rb:399-403 comment cites that consumer).

rows.name: quantity_price_break
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/quantity_price_break, fetched 2026-09-02): "The per-unit price of a variant when purchasing the minimum quantity or more." properties minimum_quantity (number), price (number); accessed via `variant.quantity_price_breaks`. Ours: no QuantityPriceBreakDrop — `grep -rn quantity_price_break app/liquid/theme_engine/` hits only app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:211 `def quantity_price_breaks = []` (VariantDrop constant empty array) and drops.rb:548 `def quantity_price_breaks_configured? = false` (ProductDrop constant); VariantDrop#quantity_rule is also a constant hash (drops.rb:212). No storage: product_variants columns (db/schema.rb:1117-1135) contain no price-break table; `grep -n price_break db/schema.rb` returns nothing.
rows.fix: Add table `variant_quantity_price_breaks` (shop_id, product_variant_id, minimum_quantity integer, price_cents bigint, composite index starting with shop_id) — B2B/volume pricing feature; add `QuantityPriceBreakDrop` (minimum_quantity, price => price_cents) and change VariantDrop#quantity_price_breaks (drops.rb:211) to map preloaded rows sorted by minimum_quantity; derive ProductDrop#quantity_price_breaks_configured? (drops.rb:548) as `variants.any? { |v| v.quantity_price_breaks.any? }`. Until the feature is scheduled the explicit [] / false constants are the correct safe-side shape.

rows.name: quantity_rule
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/quantity_rule, fetched 2026-09-02): "A variant order quantity rule." properties verbatim = min, max, increment; defaults min=1, max=nil, increment=1. Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/drops.rb:212 `def quantity_rule = { "min" => 1, "max" => nil, "increment" => 1 }` inside `class VariantDrop < Liquid::Drop` (drops.rb:132); also emitted verbatim in `as_storefront_json` at drops.rb:237. All three keys exist but are a hard-coded constant equal to the official defaults; `grep -n -i "quantity_rule\|min_order_quantity\|order_quantity\|quantity_increment\|max_quantity" db/schema.rb` returns nothing, so no DB column backs it. Correct output only for the no-rule case.

No other filter module exists (grep `module.*Filters|def color_` over app/ lib/ hits only filters.rb). 🔴 Behaviour of any filter marked `missing` below: Liquid 5.13.0 strainer_template.rb:50-57 `invoke` returns `args.first` (the input, unchanged) when the method is not invokable and `strict_filters` is false ⇒ missing filters silently pass the input through (no error, no HTML comment), so e.g. `{{ collection.url | sort_by: 'best-selling' }}` renders the bare collection URL. Windows tooling note: grep run via Git Bash with forward slashes; repo read-only, nothing written.
rows.fix: n/a

rows.name: line_items_for
rows.evidence: filters.rb:352 `def line_items_for(_cart, _obj) = []` — constant empty array regardless of cart or object. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/line_items_for): "Returns the subset of `cart` line items that include a specified product or variant." syntax `cart | line_items_for: object`, params product or variant object; example `{{ line_items | sum: 'quantity' }}` ⇒ `1`. Consequence: any theme computing per-product cart quantity gets 0.
missing_properties: object (product or variant) — parameter ignored entirely
rows.fix: In filters.rb replace the stub with: resolve `items` exactly as item_count_for_variant does (filters.rb:341-343); if `obj` is a ThemeEngine::VariantDrop (drops.rb ~line 200 family) select items whose `variant_id` == obj.id; if a ThemeEngine::ProductDrop (drops.rb:479-487 family) select items whose `product_id` == obj.id (both keys already present in cart_serializer.rb:41-42); otherwise return []. Return the item drops/hashes so `| sum: 'quantity'` works. Add spec with a cart_json fixture containing two variants of one product and assert product-level subset size 2, variant-level size 1.

rows.name: link_to_type
rows.evidence: filters.rb:205 `def link_to_type(input) = %(#{input})`. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/link_to_type): "Generates an HTML `` tag with an `href` attribute linking to a collection page that lists all products of the given product type." examples: `Health` and with `class: 'link-class'` ⇒ `Health`. Gaps: (a) our signature takes no attribute hash ⇒ `link_to_type: class: 'x'` raises ArgumentError inside the filter (Liquid rescues ArgumentError as a render error) or is dropped; (b) no `title` attribute; (c) link text not HTML-escaped; (d) `CGI.escape` encodes space as `+` whereas official example encodes `%20` (see link_to_vendor); (e) target URL `/collections/types` is not served: page_renderer.rb:208-233 treats `types` as a collection handle ⇒ not_found unless a merchant collection with that handle exists.
rows.fix: filters.rb: `def link_to_type(input, attrs = {})` building `#{CGI.escapeHTML(input)}` with attrs rendered before href (official attribute order); use `ERB::Util.url_encode` (gives %20) instead of CGI.escape. page_renderer.rb:208: add a branch for handle `types`/`vendors` that builds a VirtualAllCollection-style drop (page_renderer.rb:214) filtered by `product_type`/`vendor` = params['q'] (title = q, per official 'collection page that lists all products of the given product type').

rows.name: link_to_vendor
rows.evidence: filters.rb:203 `def link_to_vendor(input) = %(#{input})`. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/link_to_vendor): "Generates an HTML `` tag with an `href` attribute linking to a collection page that lists all products of a given product vendor." example output `Polina's Potent Potions`, with attrs ``. Ours for the same input yields `href="/collections/vendors?q=Polina%27s+Potent+Potions"` (CGI.escape ⇒ '+'), no title, no attrs param, unescaped text; `/collections/vendors` route not served (page_renderer.rb:208-233 handle lookup ⇒ not_found).
rows.fix: Same shape as link_to_type fix: `def link_to_vendor(input, attrs = {})` delegating to `url_for_vendor` with `ERB::Util.url_encode`, add escaped `title`, render attrs; add `/collections/vendors?q=` virtual collection branch in page_renderer.rb:208 filtering products by `vendor`.

rows.name: url_for_vendor
rows.evidence: filters.rb:204 `def url_for_vendor(input) = "/collections/vendors?q=#{CGI.escape(input.to_s)}"`. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/url_for_vendor): "Generates a URL for a collection page that lists all products from the given product vendor." example `{{ "Polina's Potent Potions" | url_for_vendor }}` ⇒ `/collections/vendors?q=Polina%27s%20Potent%20Potions`. Ours gives `...?q=Polina%27s+Potent+Potions` (CGI.escape uses '+' for space) — semantically equivalent query but not byte-identical to the official output; and `/collections/vendors` is not served by page_renderer.rb:208-233 (handle lookup ⇒ not_found).
rows.fix: Swap `CGI.escape` for `ERB::Util.url_encode` (percent-encodes space as %20, apostrophe as %27 — matches official output); add the vendors virtual-collection route in page_renderer.rb:208.

rows.name: within
rows.evidence: filters.rb:207 `def within(input, _c) = input.to_s` — collection argument ignored, returns the product URL unchanged. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/within): "Generates a product URL within the context of the provided collection." syntax `string | within: collection`; example `{{ collection_product.url | within: collection }}` ⇒ `/collections/sale-potions/products/draught-of-immortality`. Additionally page_renderer.rb has no `/collections/:handle/products/:handle` route (routes at lines 157 `/products/:handle`, 208 `/collections/:handle` only; header comment page_renderer.rb:9 lists the v1 route domain without the nested form).
rows.fix: filters.rb: `def within(input, collection)`: obtain collection handle (`collection.respond_to?(:handle) ? collection.handle : collection.to_s`), strip the url_prefix, and rewrite `/products/<h>` ⇒ `/collections/<chandle>/products/<h>` keeping the prefix and any `?variant=` query (VariantDrop#url drops.rb:204 appends one). page_renderer.rb: add `when %r{\A/collections/([^/]+)/products/([^/]+)\z}` that renders the product template exactly as line 157 but also injects the `collection` drop (so `collection` is set on product pages in collection context, as Shopify does).

rows.name: color_brightness
rows.evidence: filters.rb:250-254 `def color_brightness(input)`: regex `/#?(..)(..)(..)/` on the string, `((r*299+g*587+b*114)/1000.0).round(2)`; non-matching input ⇒ constant 128. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_brightness): "Calculates the perceived brightness of a given color." example `'#EA5AB9'` ⇒ `143.89`; our formula gives (69966+52830+21090)/1000 = 143.886 ⇒ 143.89 (matches). Gap: only hex6 is parsed — `rgb(234, 90, 185)`, `hsl(...)`, hex3 or hex8 inputs fall to the 128 constant (regex `..` also accepts non-hex chars, so garbage can yield 0).
missing_properties: non-hex CSS color strings (rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla()/hex3/hex8) ⇒ constant 128 fallback
rows.fix: Route through the shared Color parser (see color_to_hex fix) and keep the same 299/587/114 weighting; remove the 128 constant in favour of returning nil/empty for unparsable input (official behaviour for invalid input 未取得 — do not invent; nil is safest).

rows.name: color_darken
rows.evidence: filters.rb:268 `def color_darken(input, _p = 0) = input` — returns the input unchanged. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_darken): "Darkens a given color by a specific percentage. The percentage must be between 0 and 100." syntax `string | color_darken: number`; example `'#EA5AB9' | color_darken: 30` ⇒ `#98136b`.
rows.fix: Via shared Color object: convert to HSL, `l = [l - pct, 0].max`, back to hex6 lowercase. Spec: #EA5AB9,30 ⇒ #98136b (official).

rows.name: color_lighten
rows.evidence: filters.rb:267 `def color_lighten(input, _p = 0) = input` — input unchanged. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_lighten): "Lightens a given color by a specific percentage. The percentage must be between 0 and 100." syntax `string | color_lighten: number`; example `'#EA5AB9' | color_lighten: 30` ⇒ `#fbe2f3`.
rows.fix: Via shared Color object: HSL `l = [l + pct, 100].min` ⇒ hex6 lowercase. Spec: #EA5AB9,30 ⇒ #fbe2f3.

rows.name: color_mix
rows.evidence: filters.rb:269 `def color_mix(input, _o = nil, _p = 0) = input` — both parameters ignored. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_mix): "Blends two colors together by a specific percentage factor. The percentage must be between 0 and 100." syntax `string | color_mix: string, number`; example `'#E800B0' | color_mix: '#00936F', 50` ⇒ `#744a90`.
rows.fix: Via shared Color object: per-channel linear mix `a*pct/100 + b*(1-pct/100)` on RGB (and alpha), round, hex6. Verify against official: (0xE8*0.5+0)=116=0x74, (0+0x93*0.5)=73.5⇒0x4a, (0xB0*0.5+0x6F*0.5)=143.5⇒0x90 — matches `#744a90` with round-half-down/`.round` semantics to confirm in spec.

rows.name: color_modify
rows.evidence: filters.rb:258-265 `def color_modify(input, key = nil, value = nil)`: only `key == 'alpha'` is handled (builds `rgba(r, g, b, value)` from ColorDrop); every other component returns `input.to_s` unchanged (`return input.to_s unless key.to_s == "alpha"` at :259, comment :256-257 '其餘鍵維持原樣（登記）'). Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_modify): "Modifies a specific color component of a given color by a specific amount." syntax `string | color_modify: string, number`; ranges red/green/blue 0-255, alpha 0-1, hue 0-360, saturation/lightness 0-100; example `'#EA5AB9' | color_modify: 'red', 255` ⇒ `#ff5ab9`.
rows.fix: Rewrite on the shared Color object: set the named component (clamp to official range), serialize: hex6 when alpha == 1, `rgba(r, g, b, a)` when alpha < 1 (keeps the existing alpha branch's output shape which Ella overlays rely on). Spec: #EA5AB9 red 255 ⇒ #ff5ab9; alpha 0.5 ⇒ rgba(234, 90, 185, 0.5).

rows.name: color_to_rgb
rows.evidence: filters.rb:266 `def color_to_rgb(input) = input` — returns input unchanged (a hex stays hex). Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_to_rgb): "Converts a CSS color string to `RGB` format." alpha note verbatim: "If a color with an alpha component is provided, then the color is converted to `RGBA` format." example `'#EA5AB9' | color_to_rgb` ⇒ `rgb(234, 90, 185)`.
rows.fix: On shared Color: `to_rgb` ⇒ `rgb(r, g, b)` (comma+space format per official output) or `rgba(r, g, b, a)` when alpha < 1. Spec: #EA5AB9 ⇒ rgb(234, 90, 185); #EA5AB980 ⇒ rgba(234, 90, 185, 0.5).

rows.name: avatar

rows.name: customer_logout_link

rows.name: login_button
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/login_button, 2026-09-02): "Generates an HTML Button that enables a customer to either sign in to the storefront using their Shop account or follow the shop in the Shop App." Syntax `shop | login_button`; param `action`: `default` = "Authentication only", `follow` = "Performs a side-effect after authentication which follows the current shop in the Shop app". Do not fabricate Shop-app markup.

rows.name: font_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/font_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for the provided font in `woff2` format." Format values `woff2` (default), `woff`; example `font_url: 'woff'` → a `.woff` URL. Ours: filters.rb:226-228 `def font_url(input, _format = "woff2")` returns `input.file.to_s` for FontDrop regardless of format (comment: "'woff' 請求同回 woff2 URL（⚪ 97 §1.3）"). config/storefront_fonts.yml variants carry a single `file` (font_library.rb:65-72).
rows.fix: Add optional `file_woff` per variant in config/storefront_fonts.yml and FontDrop (drops.rb:1766); `font_url(input, format)` returns `file_woff` when format == "woff" and present, else woff2. Already registered ⚪ 97 §1.3 — leave as accepted deviation if woff hosting is out of scope.

rows.name: date
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/date, 2026-09-02): "Converts a timestamp into another date format." Positional strftime string; named `format:` values `abbreviated_date`, `basic`, `date`, `date_at_time`, `default`, `on_date`, `short` (deprecated), `long` (deprecated); "You can define custom date formats in your theme's storefront locale files… included in a `date_formats` category." `{{ 'now' | date: … }}` supported. Ours: filters.rb:191-196 `def date(input, fmt = "%Y-%m-%d")` — strftime only; if a Hash `{"format"=>"abbreviated_date"}` is passed, `fmt.to_s` yields the Hash's inspect string and strftime returns it literally; no lookup of locale `date_formats` (`grep -rln date_formats config/ app/` → none); `'now'` string goes through `Time.zone.parse("now")` → nil → falls to `Time.zone.now` (works by accident). Note: the gem's StandardFilters#date is overridden by ours because register_filter(Filters) at runtime.rb:24.
missing_properties: format (named: abbreviated_date, basic, date, date_at_time, default, on_date)
rows.fix: In filters.rb:191 accept `fmt` as Hash: when `fmt["format"]` present, resolve pattern from `@context.registers[:locale_dict]["date_formats"][name]` (theme locale) falling back to a platform table for the six named formats (+ short/long aliases; exact strftime patterns per name 未取得 — capture from test store output for each name and lock as fixture); handle `'now'`/`'today'` explicitly; keep strftime path for strings.

rows.name: structured_data
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/structured_data, 2026-09-02): "Converts an object into a schema.org structured data format."; "can be used on the `product` and `article` objects"; Product → schema.org `Product` (no variants) or `ProductGroup` (with variants); Article → `Article`; example output starts `{"@context":"http://schema.org/","@id":"/products/crocodile-tears#product","@type":"Product","brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":…},…"offers":{"@id":"…?variant=…#offer","@type":"Offer","availability":"http://schema.org/OutOfStock","price":"56.00","priceCurrency":"CAD","url":…},"url":…}`. Ours: filters.rb:272 `def structured_data(_input) = ""` (constant empty) — theme `<script type="application/ld+json">` blocks emit an empty body.
rows.fix: Implement in filters.rb (or a new app/liquid/theme_engine/structured_data.rb): for ProductDrop build the official key set (@context, @id "#{url}#product", @type Product|ProductGroup, brand, category, description, image with width=1920, name, offers{@id,@type,availability InStock/OutOfStock,price as Money::Decimal 2dp per 鐵律 3, priceCurrency, url}, url); for ArticleDrop emit `Article` (headline, datePublished, author, image — exact keys 未取得, capture from test store); JSON.generate; other inputs → "". Spec with JPY/TWD to lock the decimal-string price.

rows.name: weight_with_unit
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/weight_with_unit, 2026-09-02): "Generates a formatted weight for a variant object. The weight unit is set in the general settings in the Shopify admin." Example: variant.weight 200 with default kg → `"0.2 kg"`; with unit override `weight_with_unit: variant.weight_unit` ("g") → `"200 g"`. Ours: filters.rb:369 `def weight_with_unit(input, _u = nil) = "#{input} g"` — ignores the override argument and the shop default unit, always appends " g" with no conversion; VariantDrop#weight_unit is a constant "kg" (drops.rb:203) and no shop-level weight unit exists (`grep -rn weight_unit app/models db/schema.rb` → none).
missing_properties: shop default weight unit (kg conversion, e.g. 200 → 0.2 kg)
rows.fix: Implement `weight_with_unit(grams, unit = nil)`: unit = override || shop default (add `weight_unit` column/setting on shops, default "kg" per drops.rb:203 probe 83 §12); convert grams → kg (/1000), lb (/453.59237), oz (/28.349523125), g (as-is); format with trailing zeros stripped (`0.2 kg`, `200 g`); spec the two official examples.

rows.name: asset_img_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/hosted_file-filters, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for an image in the assets directory of a theme." `size` optional, "Default is `small` (100 x 100 px)"; output `…/assets/red-and-black-bramble-berries_small.jpg?v=337`, with `'large'` → `_large.jpg`. Ours: filters.rb:37 `def asset_img_url(input, _size = nil) = asset_url(input)` — size ignored, no `_small`/`_large` suffix, serves original via Storefront::AssetsController (assets_controller.rb:20-35, route routes.rb:80 `theme-assets/*file`); no `?v=` version query.

rows.name: file_img_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/file_img_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for an image from the Files page of the Shopify admin."; "By default, the `file_img_url` filter returns the `small` version of the image (100 x 100 px)." Output `//…/cdn/shop/files/potions-header_small.png?v=…`, `'large'` → `_large`. Ours: filters.rb:39 `def file_img_url(input, _s = nil) = asset_url(input)` — resolves to `/theme-assets/<name>` i.e. the THEME assets directory, not the shop Files store (StoredFile); size ignored. The correct Files resolver exists at runtime.rb:246-254 `resolve_settings_file` (StoredFile by shop_id+filename) and the media route routes.rb:82 `media/:id/:filename` with ?width/?height support (media_controller.rb:15-31) but the filter does not use them.

rows.fix: Rewrite filters.rb:39: `rt = @context.registers[:runtime]; f = rt&.resolve_settings_file(input)`; return `sized_media_url(f.url, width:, height:)` per named size (small=100, medium=240, large=480, grande=600, etc. — official px table 未取得 beyond small=100, verify) else placeholder_url; fall back to asset_url only when no StoredFile matches (Ella uses file_img_url for theme-shipped files).

rows.name: file_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/file_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for a file from the Files page of the Shopify admin." Example `{{ 'disclaimer.pdf' | file_url }}` → `//…/cdn/shop/files/disclaimer.pdf?v=…`. Ours: filters.rb:38 `def file_url(input) = asset_url(input)` — points at theme assets (`/theme-assets/disclaimer.pdf`), so admin-uploaded Files (StoredFile, resolved at runtime.rb:246-254, served at routes.rb:82 media/:id/:filename) are unreachable through this filter.
rows.fix: Same as file_img_url: resolve via `@context.registers[:runtime].resolve_settings_file(input)` and return the StoredFile media URL (`/media/{id}/{filename}`), falling back to asset_url when not found.

rows.name: global_asset_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/global_asset_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for a global asset. Global assets are kept in a directory on Shopify's server. Using global assets can be faster than loading the resource directly." Example `'lightbox.js' | global_asset_url` → `//…/cdn/s/global/lightbox.js`. Ours: filters.rb:41 `def global_asset_url(input) = asset_url(input)` → `/theme-assets/lightbox.js`, which only resolves if the theme itself ships that file (assets_controller.rb:29-31 reads from theme source); no platform-global directory exists.

rows.name: shopify_asset_url
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/shopify_asset_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for a globally accessible Shopify asset." Example `'option_selection.js' | shopify_asset_url` → `//…/cdn/shopifycloud/storefront/assets/themes_support/option_selection-b017cd28.js`; note lists option_selection.js, api.jquery.js, shopify_common.js, customer_area.js, currencies.js, customer.css. Ours: filters.rb:40 `def shopify_asset_url(input) = asset_url(input)` → `/theme-assets/option_selection.js`; no platform copies of those support scripts exist in app/ (they are Shopify-proprietary and cannot be copied — 鐵律 9).

Do not copy Shopify's files.

rows.name: highlight

rows.name: image_url
rows.evidence: Ours: filters.rb:60-80 `def image_url(input, opts = {})` reads only opts["width"]/opts["height"] (:61-62) → sized_media_url :141-146 appends `?width=&height=`; comment :56-59 states format is swallowed ("format 參數吞掉不編出"). Consumer app/controllers/storefront/media_controller.rb:39-50 `pick_variant` selects fit derivatives by width/height only (FIT_VARIANTS thumb/card/detail, :14) and always serves image/webp (:24). Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/image_url, 2026-09-02): "Returns the CDN URL for an image." params width (≤5760), height (≤5760), crop (top/center/bottom/left/right/region + crop_left/crop_top/crop_width/crop_height), format (pjpg/jpg), pad_color (hex3/hex6), quality (10–90); "Either width or height must be specified".

rows.name: url_param_escape
rows.evidence:
Official https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/url_param_escape (2026-09-02): "Escapes any characters in a string that are unsafe for URL parameters." Escapes same as url_escape plus `&`; example `'

Health & Love potions

' | url_param_escape` => `%3Cp%3EHealth%20%26%20Love%20potions%3C/p%3E` (space→%20, `/` kept). Ours: app/liquid/theme_engine/filters.rb:201 `def url_param_escape(input) = CGI.escape(input.to_s)`. Drop-side partial data exists: ColorDrop drops.rb:1689-1706 exposes red/green/blue (parsed) but `alpha` is constant 1.0 (:1700), `hue` and `saturation` are constant 0 (:1703-1704), `lightness` is a brightness-based approximation (:1705), so even a delegation to ColorDrop would be wrong for hue/saturation. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_extract): "Extracts a specific color component from a given color." components alpha, red, green, blue, hue, saturation, lightness; example `'#EA5AB9' | color_extract: 'red'` ⇒ `234`.
rows.fix: `def color_extract(input, component)` on the shared Color object returning integer red/green/blue (0-255), float alpha (0-1), hue (0-360), saturation/lightness (0-100, HSL). Also fix ColorDrop drops.rb:1700-1705 to compute real alpha (hex8/rgba), hue and saturation from the same object so `settings.color.hue` and the filter agree (鐵律 7 同源精神). rows.name: color_saturate
rows.evidence: No `def color_saturate` in filters.rb. Passes input through. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_saturate): "Saturates a given color by a specific percentage. The percentage must be between 0 and 100." syntax `string | color_saturate: number`; example `'#EA5AB9' | color_saturate: 30` ⇒ `#ff45c0`.
rows.fix: Via shared Color object: HSL `s = [s + pct, 100].min` ⇒ hex6. Spec: #EA5AB9,30 ⇒ #ff45c0.

rows.name: color_to_hex
rows.evidence: No `def color_to_hex` in filters.rb. Passes input through (so `rgb(234, 90, 185)` stays as-is). Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_to_hex): "Converts a CSS color string to hexadecimal format (`hex6`)." example `'rgb(234, 90, 185)' | color_to_hex` ⇒ `#ea5ab9`.
rows.fix: Introduce `ThemeEngine::Color` (new file app/liquid/theme_engine/color.rb, pure Ruby, no new gem — 鐵律 1) parsing hex3/hex6/hex8, `rgb()/rgba()`, `hsl()/hsla()` (named colors 未取得 in official page — omit), holding r,g,b (0-255 floats), a (0-1), with `to_hex` (lowercase hex6, per official output), `to_rgb`, `to_hsl`, `to_oklch`, `hsl` accessors, `mix`, `brightness`, `luminance`. All 15 color filters become one-liners over it, and ColorDrop (drops.rb:1689) wraps it. Add spec/liquid/theme_engine/color_filters_spec.rb pinning every official example output listed in these rows.

rows.name: color_to_hsl
rows.evidence: No `def color_to_hsl` in filters.rb. Passes input through. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_to_hsl): "Converts a CSS color string to `HSL` format." alpha note verbatim: "If a color with an alpha component is provided, the color is converted to `HSLA` format." example `'#EA5AB9' | color_to_hsl` ⇒ `hsl(320, 77%, 64%)`.
rows.fix: On shared Color: `to_hsl` ⇒ `hsl(H, S%, L%)` with integer-rounded H/S/L; when alpha < 1 ⇒ `hsla(H, S%, L%, A)`. Spec: #EA5AB9 ⇒ hsl(320, 77%, 64%).

rows.name: color_to_oklch
rows.evidence: No `def color_to_oklch` in filters.rb. Passes input through. Official (WebFetch 2026-09-02 https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/color_to_oklch): "Converts a CSS color string to `OKLCH` format." example `'#EA5AB9' | color_to_oklch` ⇒ `oklch(68% 0.2 343 / 1.0)`.
rows.fix: On shared Color: sRGB ⇒ linear ⇒ OKLab (Björn Ottosson matrices, public domain/MIT reference https://bottosson.github.io/posts/oklab/) ⇒ LCH; serialize `oklch(L% C H / A)` with L rounded to integer percent, C to 1-2 decimals, H integer, A as `1.0` (official output shows `/ 1.0` even for opaque). Spec: #EA5AB9 ⇒ oklch(68% 0.2 343 / 1.0); rounding precision of C must be confirmed against additional official examples — only one example available, so mark C precision V if it cannot be pinned.

rows.name: hex_to_rgba
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/hex_to_rgba, fetched 2026-09-02): "Converts a CSS color string from hexadecimal format to `RGBA` format. Shorthand hexadecimal formatting (`hex3`) is also accepted." Deprecation: "The `hex_to_rgba` filter has been replaced by `color_to_rgb` and `color_modify`." Param `alpha` (number, optional) "Accepts decimal values between 0.0 and 1.0; defaults to 1.0"; example `{{ '#EA5AB9' | hex_to_rgba: 0.5 }}` → `rgba(234,90,185,0.5)`. Ours: `grep -rn hex_to_rgba app/ config/ lib/` → zero hits (no def in app/liquid/theme_engine/filters.rb; Filters module registered at runtime.rb:24 `e.register_filter(Filters)`). Liquid 5.13.0 raises/ignores unknown filters ⇒ templates using it get raw input.
rows.fix: Add to app/liquid/theme_engine/filters.rb color section: `def hex_to_rgba(input, alpha = 1.0)` — expand 3-digit hex to 6 (`#abc`→`#aabbcc`), reuse ThemeEngine::ColorDrop (drops.rb:1689) for r/g/b, output exactly `rgba(r,g,b,a)` with no spaces (official example form); clamp alpha 0.0–1.0. Mark deprecated in comment; add spec for hex6, hex3 and alpha.

rows.name: default_pagination
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/default_pagination, 2026-09-02): "Generates HTML for a set of links for paginated results. rows.name: font_face
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/font-filters, 2026-09-02): "Generates a CSS `@font_face` declaration to load the provided font." Param `font_display` (optional string). Example output `@font-face { font-family: Assistant; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; src: url("…woff2") format("woff2"); }`. Ours: filters.rb:213-223 `def font_face(input, opts = {})` — reads `opts["font_display"]`, emits family/weight/style/optional font-display/src woff2 in the same order; returns "" for system fonts (FontDrop#file nil, drops.rb:1766-1787). Note comment 97 §1.3: single woff2 src vs live dual-src (⚪ registered).

rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/font_modify, 2026-09-02): "Modifies a specific property of a given font." `style`: normal, italic, oblique; `weight`: 100–900, normal, bold, +100–+900, -100–-900, lighter, bolder; "If the `font_modify` filter tries to create a font variant that doesn't exist, then it returns `nil`." rows.name: unit_price_with_measurement
rows.evidence: Official (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/unit_price_with_measurement, 2026-09-02): "Formats a given unit price and measurement based on the store's HTML without currency setting." Syntax `number | unit_price_with_measurement: unit_price_measurement`; example `$50.00/kg`; pre-formatted `money_with_currency` input → `$50.00 CAD/kg`. Ours: filters.rb:358-368 `def unit_price_with_measurement(input, measurement = nil)` — formats integer cents via format_money, reads reference_value/reference_unit via dig_measurement (filters.rb:387-392), emits `price/unit` or `price/100ml` when reference_value>1. Gap: a pre-formatted string input (`money_with_currency | unit_price_with_measurement`) is re-run through format_money(`input.to_f/100`) → wrong; and VariantDrop#unit_price/unit_price_measurement are nil constants (drops.rb:206-207) so no real data feeds it yet.
rows.fix: In filters.rb:358 pass `input` through unformatted when it is a String that is not purely numeric (already money-formatted); populate VariantDrop#unit_price (integer cents) and #unit_price_measurement from variant columns once the schema carries them.

Partial analogs only: LiquidHTMLSyntaxError≈ Liquid-only parse at app/services/themes/import_zip.rb:181-185 and runtime.rb:288-294 (Liquid::SyntaxError → @errors; HTML not checked); JSONSyntaxError≈ runtime.rb:42-49 tolerant_json (more lenient than the rule — comments/trailing commas pass); MissingTemplate/MissingAsset≈ render-time warning runtime.rb:297 `@warnings << "檔案不存在: #{rel}"` and SnippetFS FileSystemError runtime.rb:469-470 (render-time, not lint); UndefinedObject≈ `ThemeEngine.count_miss` telemetry in drops.rb liquid_method_missing (e.g. drops.rb:1889, :1983) and tags.rb:280 — runtime miss counters, not static analysis. None of the 67 named rules exists as a check.
rows.fix: Do not reimplement the 67 rules in Ruby; wire upstream `@shopify/theme-check-node` (MIT) into import_zip compat_scan and the code-editor save path (ThemeFileOverlay) and persist its JSON offenses (check name, severity, file, line) into ThemeImportReport; expose via GraphQL for the admin editor. For the CI side add `scripts/theme-check-fixture.mjs` running recommended rules against test/fixtures/themes/ella-7.2.0 to catch engine regressions (RequiredLayoutThemeObject, MissingTemplate, UnknownFilter are the ones that double as engine-coverage signals).
